items.title: Can Interactive 3D Improve Digital Textbooks Without Making Reading More Complicated?
items.excerpt: Digital textbook publishers can now use AI text-to-3D tools to turn lesson descriptions into interactive 3D models, but the piece argues they should deploy the technology selectively where it clarifies spatial or internal structures that flat images cannot.

items.title: New study: audiobook listeners willing to try AI multi-cast narration; rate it favorably
items.excerpt: A new study commissioned by AI audiobook producer Spoken found that in blind testing, listeners rated AI multi-cast narration as slightly better than human narration on character-driven scenes, a signal that AI-voiced production tools may be nearing acceptance for full-cast fiction audiobooks.
